$comment: Pi-side settings for the mcp-combiner extension's client half. Copy to $PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR/extensions/mcp-combiner.json (default ~/.config/pi/agent/extensions/). Connection URL and per-project server exposure live in the shared MCP config ladder (.pi/mcp.json / ~/.config/mcp/mcp.json) instead — see README. Env vars (PI_MCP_COMBINER_*) win over this file. adapter: true = we are the MCP tool; false = this extension only launches the process + injects instructions (pi-mcp-adapter owns MCP); 'auto' (default) = false when pi-mcp-adapter is installed, true otherwise. The client half is native mode: the pi-mcp transport with per-tool pi-1.0 registration + the mcp router.
